basic_info.description: Come put your finishing touches on this beautiful 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom home on a sunny lot, measuring 25' wide and over 100' long (according to county records). Bonus rooms on the ground floor feature a kitchenette, staircase to upper level, adjoining bathroom, internal garage access and best of all, sliding door access to the flat, sunny, privacy fenced rear yard. Tax records indicate the home measures approximately 2,200 SF. Entry via a long breezeway with direct access to the 2 car, side-by-side garage. Recently updated gas hot water heater, recently updated gas/hot air furnace and washer/ dryer hook-ups present in the garage. Probate with no court confirmation required. A fire occurred in the kitchen in 2024. The insurance company has completed the following abatements on the property: smoke, mold, asbestos and lead based paint. The home utilities (gas, electric, water) remain current but shut off at the home for safety reasons. The upper level of the home has been stripped to the studs whereas the ground floor was not directly impacted by the fire.
